opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN + GitHub repo lookup, then log lead note
opportunities.description: For a tech topic, search Hacker News for the top story, search GitHub for the repo, then write a 'Lead:' note with HN title, points, age, GitHub stars and latest release.
steps: Open Hacker News search (HN or Algolia) and search the topic
Note top story title, points and age
Open GitHub, click the search box and search the topic
Open the top matching repository and read stars and latest release
Open Notes, click New note, type 'Lead: <topic>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars>, last release <date>' and press Enter

opportunities.name: World Bank Open Data country search
opportunities.description: Search a country in the World Bank Open Data search box and open its country data page (some used for fact-checking).
steps: Open World Bank Open Data home
Click the search data box
Type the country name (try official naming, e.g. Viet Nam)
Select the matching country suggestion or press Enter
Read the indicator value

opportunities.description: Search BBC News for a topic and open the top article, to use as context in a note.
steps: Open BBC News
Click Open menu
Click the search box
Type the query and press Enter
Open the top result
